name: DC Hub - Data Center Intelligence
description: Real-time data center infrastructure intelligence for AI agents. 50,000+ facilities across 140+ countries.

tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Search and filter 50,000+ global data center facilities by location, capacity, operator, market, and more.

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific data center facility including capacity, power, connectivity, and operator details.

tools.name: get_market_intel
tools.description: Market intelligence including supply/demand, pricing, vacancy rates, absorption, and pipeline data for major data center markets.

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Track 21+ GW of data center construction pipeline globally — announced, under construction, and planned capacity.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Retrieve M&A transactions in the data center industry including buyer, seller, deal value, capacity, and market.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Curated data center industry news aggregated from 40+ authoritative sources.

tools.name: analyze_site
tools.description: Evaluate a geographic location for data center suitability — power, fiber, climate, water, carbon, tax incentives, and market dynamics.

tools.name: compare_sites
tools.description: Compare 2-4 locations for data center suitability side-by-side across all infrastructure dimensions.

tools.name: get_energy_prices
tools.description: Retail electricity rates, natural gas prices, and grid reliability data by state and market.

tools.name: get_grid_data
tools.description: Real-time electricity grid data for US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, etc.) and international grids.

tools.name: get_infrastructure
tools.description: Nearby power infrastructure — substations, transmission lines, gas pipelines — for any US location.

tools.name: get_fiber_intel
tools.description: Dark fiber routes, carrier networks, lit services, and connectivity intelligence across 20 major data center markets.

tools.name: get_renewable_energy
tools.description: Renewable energy capacity data — solar farms, wind farms, and combined generation by state and market.

tools.name: get_tax_incentives
tools.description: Data center tax incentives by US state — sales tax exemptions, property tax abatements, and other incentive programs.

tools.name: get_water_risk
tools.description: Water stress and drought risk assessment for data center locations using USGS and climate data.
